contentHtml:
一、课程介绍

“中央银行管理-国际经验”课程为德意志联邦银行应用科技大学专门支持清华大学五道口金融学院的实务性课程，至今已有近20年历史。德意志联邦银行应用科技大学成立于1976年，是一所以中央银行管理为专业方向的公立高等专业院校，为德意志联邦银行（德国中央银行）每年培养约100名新成员，并为欧盟央行行政官员提供培训的机构。

2026年“中央银行管理-国际经验”课程共邀请3位教授，分别为Prof. Dr. Andreas Kremer（校长、教授）、Prof. Dr. Andreas Höfer（教授）及 Prof. Uwe Schollmeyer（教授）。三位教授将从不同的角度介绍欧洲一体化进程，银行业的监管，金融稳定与宏观审慎等，辅以详实的数据、史料，深入分析政策及措施的合理性和内容。

课程将为同学们带来关于欧洲货币体系、相关历史、文化和传统的精彩介绍，是一门不可多得的课程。

二、 课程内容及时间安排（以实际安排为准）

1. 主讲人: Prof. Dr. Andreas Kremer ---“Monetary Union and Banking Union – Motivation, structure and current challenges”

The course provides an insight into the European integration process. Particularly, it covers the main economic aspects and the current developments of the European Union, the European Monetary Union and the European Banking Union. The topics of the course are related to the creation of the Single European Market, the European Monetary Union, and the European Banking Union. The main focus is on the discussion of the rationale, the content, and the implications of various policies, such as fiscal and monetary policies, in the context of European integration. In each lecture, the course aims to point out the advantages and disadvantages of these measures for governments, the business sector, and individuals.

10月20日（周二）, 14:00-16:30, 金融学院4-101

10月21日（周三）, 14:00-16:30, 金融学院4-101

10月22日（周四）, 14:00-16:30, 金融学院4-101

2. 主讲人: Prof. Dr. Andreas Höfer ---“Supervisory review of banks´ business models”

Effective regulation of the banking sector constitutes a fundamental prerequisite for mitigating systemic risks and limiting contagion dynamics. In response, the European Union has introduced a regulatory framework that places particular emphasis on the sustainability of banks’ business models and the identification of relevant risks. Within the scope of the course, best-practice approaches for strategic management and the design of resilient banking business models are examined. Moreover, the course addresses the relevance, risks, and regulation of Non-Banking Financial Intermediaries (NBFIs).

10月27日（周二）, 14:00-16:30, 金融学院4-101

10月28日（周三），14:00-16:30, 金融学院4-101

10月29日（周四）, 14:00-16:30, 金融学院4-101

3. 主讲人：Prof. Uwe Schollmeyer ---“Financial Stability and Macroprudential Policy: A European Perspective”

This course provides an introduction to the fundamentals of macroprudential policy and its role in safeguarding financial stability. Students will explore both cyclical and structural vulnerabilities within the financial system, including how risks build up over time and the impact of interconnectedness and risk concentration. The course covers the concept of resilience, methods for assessing risks to financial stability, and the objectives, approaches, and limitations of macroprudential policy. Key macroprudential instruments will be discussed, as well as the roles of various institutions and stakeholders in maintaining financial stability. Finally, the course addresses crisis management strategies and the design of financial safety nets to mitigate the impact of financial crises.

11月3日（周二），14:00-16:30, 金融学院4-101

11月4日（周三），14:00-16:30, 金融学院4-101

11月5日（周四），14:00-16:30, 金融学院4-101

11月6日（周五），14:00-16:30, 金融学院4-101

三、报名方式

本课程课号为80601262，共2学分。

清华大学在读研究生均可在规定的选课时间内，通过info选课系统选课。

四、考核标准

课程考核方式为英文闭卷笔试，时长2小时，考试时间与地点请等待进一步通知。

五、联系方式

联系人：曹老师

地址：清华大学五道口金融学院教学办公室4-401室

电话：62706129

邮箱：caolt@pbcsf.tsinghua.edu.cn
